chose: Split compose's root in two. REPO_ROOT is the tree the release's tracked files are read from: home's deploy makes it a worktree at the release's commit. A new STATE_ROOT, which envctl sets to the owner's checkout (for make up and the deploy alike), serves the four mounts of state git does not hold: file_host's data (rw), logs (rw) and config (the gitignored FCM key), and Grafana's built dashboards. envctl check refuses any ${REPO_ROOT} bind mount that is writable or names an untracked path (RL10).
options: Split the root: REPO_ROOT for the release's tree, STATE_ROOT for untracked state
Move that state under ${STORAGE} with a one-time move on home
No worktree: compose from the owner's checkout with only IMAGE_* from origin/main's release
gray: Decided by the coordinator, not the owner. The owner's standing 'go with the recommended where a choice is open' was not restated today, so this rests on the coordinator's reading of it. Why it was the coordinator's to make: it changes nothing on home and nothing the owner does, since make up is unchanged and no state moves; it is reversible; and it keeps server#787's decided release worktree. Moving the state under STORAGE is cleaner long-term but needs the owner to move files on the box. Dropping the worktree would undo a decision #787 recorded. Either would have gone to the owner.
undo: Point the five STATE_ROOT lines (three in file_host.yml, two in monitoring.yml) back at REPO_ROOT, drop --state-root and STATE_ROOT from FROM_MAKE, delete mounts.rs with its mod and mounts::problems call in main.rs, retire RL10 in docs/release.md, and have the deploy run compose from the owner's checkout.
